acceptanceCriteria: Every Go test fixture that hides the global Git config and runs a Git subcommand that triggers auto maintenance passes -c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0 (or an equivalent isolated config), or is shown not to need it; the list in the body is resolved file by file.

The AFP-V0-039 fixture-maintenance guard (internal/liveverify/affected/fixture_maintenance_test.go) is widened from internal/liveverify to the repository's Go test sources, or a recorded reason names why not; focused tests pass and the guard fails on a planted unguarded fixture.
body: Found during V1-0662 (batch G): the guard added for internal/liveverify/affected/** fixtures found 74 other Go test files outside its scope that hide the host's global Git config (HOME= or GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL) and run commit/fetch/merge/rebase/etc. without -c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0. These can launch a detached git maintenance that races TempDir cleanup, the same CI flake class as V1-0662. List retained at the time: /private/tmp/claude-501/v0662-td/outofscope.txt (first entries cmd/corvint-analyzer-go/production_spy_darwin_test.go, cmd/corvint-corpus-mcp/mapplan_test.go, cmd/corvint-corpus-parity/main_test.go). Prefer a shared test helper over 74 hand edits where a package already has one.

All 15 hosted CI checks passed on head b6f3eb78. The batch CEM was bound, checked and sealed (commit 1e15a6f1), and Codex reviewed each lane and the integration. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-08-v1-1030-fixture-maintenance.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-08-batch-i-integration.md at that commit (each digest is that file’s sha256); the build logs record the focused tests and limits. title: Git test fixtures outside liveverify run auto-maintenance subcommands without maintenance safeguards (74 files)
